label: AML Technology Selection Support
description: Evaluates and compares AML/CFT technology solutions (transaction monitoring, screening, case management, KYC). Produces structured vendor comparison and selection recommendation.

claudeKnowledge.description: AML technology vendors, transaction monitoring platforms, screening solutions, KYC technology landscape

guidedInputs.label: Technology Category
guidedInputs.description: What type of AML technology is being evaluated?

options.label: AI/ML Analytics (e.g. network analysis, anomaly detection)

guidedInputs.label: Institution Profile
guidedInputs.description: Describe the institution: size, customer base, transaction volumes, current technology, and key pain points with current solution.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Mid-size Scandinavian bank. 180,000 customers. 2.5M transactions/month. Currently using legacy on-prem TM system (10+ years old). Key pain points: high false positive rate (97%), no network analysis, limited cloud integration, manual SAR process...

guidedInputs.label: Vendors / Solutions Under Consideration
guidedInputs.description: List the specific vendors or solutions being evaluated. Upload RFP responses or vendor materials via the file uploader.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. NICE Actimize (NICE AML Essentials), Nasdaq BWise, Oracle Financial Services, ComplyAdvantage, Hawk AI, Quantexa...

guidedInputs.label: Key Selection Criteria
guidedInputs.description: What are the most important criteria for this selection?

options.label: Detection Quality (false positive rate, typology coverage)

guidedInputs.label: Budget and Timeline Constraints
guidedInputs.description: Available budget and implementation timeline requirements.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Budget: €800k–1.2M total (license + implementation). Go-live required by Q3 2026 to meet regulatory readiness deadline...

guidedInputs.label: Technical and Operational Requirements
guidedInputs.description: Key technical requirements: data volumes, integration points, regulatory jurisdiction, cloud policy.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Must integrate with Temenos T24 core banking and Snowflake data warehouse. Cloud preferred but data residency must stay within EU. Volume: 2.5M transactions/month peak 8M/month. Must support Swedish, Finnish, and Danish language interfaces...
